title: Rooftop Terrace with Panoramic Pyramid Views
description: Relax in our exclusive rooftop lounge featuring breathtaking panoramic views of the Giza Pyramids, perfect for sunrise breakfasts, sunset gatherings, and unforgettable evenings.

title: International & Traditional Breakfast Selection
description: Start your day with a carefully curated breakfast experience offering Modern Egyptian specialties, authentic traditional dishes, and a variety of European favorites.

title: Pyramid-View Café & Restaurant
description: Enjoy exceptional dining and handcrafted beverages in our elegant café and restaurant overlooking the iconic Pyramids in a warm and sophisticated atmosphere.

title: Complimentary High-Speed Wi-Fi
description: Stay seamlessly connected throughout your stay with fast, reliable, and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi available across all rooms and public areas.

title: Daily Housekeeping Service
description: Experience comfort and cleanliness every day with our professional housekeeping service, ensuring your room remains fresh, organized, and welcoming.

title: Private Daily Tours Across Egypt
description: Discover Egypt in comfort with customized private tours to top destinations including Cairo, Luxor, Aswan, Alexandria, desert adventures, and Nile experiences.
